confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Canggu pricing, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and July is peak season, so rates may run above typical levels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer level in local bars, since direct knowledge is weaker. FX provenance: the 0.6955 value comes from search-result snippets attributed to RBA data for 15 October 2026. I did not open the rba.gov.au page, and another snippet showed 0.7002 for 14 October, so the value should be verified against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Bali tourist-zone price levels, using Seminyak and Ubud as informal reference points, plus typical Southeast Asian beach-town pricing for Canggu's cafe and villa-stay scene. No single named comparable city was used.
